body:
If you want your logo or any design project to stand out by using the best military style fonts, then you’re at the right place.

What is the best military font for logo design and branding?

As a logo designer who is working with a client that wants a stencil or army-inspired design, having the best military font will be a huge advantage.

The same goes with small business owners that are selling products and souvenirs that have a patriotic design.

However, since there are a lot of military fonts that are available online, it might be hard for you to know which one of them is suitable for your needs.

Thankfully, there are resources that are very reliable when it comes to finding the best fonts for logo designers, and Creative Market and Design Cuts are great examples.

This article is perfect for you if you’re looking for the best military style font for designing logos and branding materials.

To give you some ideas, Bootcamp is definitely the best military font for army-inspired game design.

On the other hand, the Union Force will be an ideal choice for business owners that want to have the best military stencil typeface for t-shirt design.

All these navy-inspired typefaces on my list are highly recommended, so without keeping you waiting, here’s my list of the 10 best military fonts in 2023.

10 Best Military Fonts

  1. Headcorps & Lordcorps
  2. Airborne 86
  3. Poligon
  4. Military font
  5. Bootcamp
  6. The Old Navy
  7. Chaser
  8. Northolt
  9. Union Force
  10. Autobahn SVG

By the way, you can also check out my other article where I listed the best stencil fonts for designers.

1. Headcorps & Lordcorps

I want to start my list with this Headcorps & Lordcorps military font, which is inspired by the classic vintage military stencil design.

Headcorps and Lordcorps are the best overall military fonts.

It is specifically created to cater to the needs of any designer that is working on any military-inspired project.‍

The Headcorps and Lordcorps is without a doubt the best military font for design and branding.

This military stencil typeface is suitable for use for wallpaper, pattern fills, web page backgrounds, and surface textures.

It is also perfect for making army posters, invitation cards, label stickers, stationary, packaging, clothes, pendants, holiday gifts, printing on fabrics and so much more.

Additionally, it is accessible in Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign, and even works on Microsoft Word.

‍Download Headcorps & Lordcorps now

2. Airborne 86

If you’re a logo designer who is looking for the best sans-military style font, then this Airborne 86 typeface is a must-have.

Airborne is the best sans-military font for any design project.

This military typeface comes with a very unique style, and its characters do not have that many sharp edges compared to other fonts.

It is also designed to have random cuts and lines in the letters, which gives the Airborne 86 a classic and professional-looking vibe.

This military font can be widely used for any design and branding projects, especially for designing posters about the air force and army.

The Airborne 86 also comes in 2 styles, which are regular and stencil, in which they are both ideal for military-inspired logos.

‍Download Airborne 86 now

3. Poligon

The Poligon, the next typeface on this list, is one of my favorite military fonts.

Poligon is the best military font for logo design.

Poligon is one of the best military font families and it is inspired by the military and aviation style.

This typeface includes six styles, which are regular, rough, printed, stencil, stencil rough, and stencil printed.

It is an all-capital-letter font that is very easy to use and it has OpenType features.

Overall, Poligon is an amazing choice for logo designers that are looking for the best military font for creating both modern and vintage designs.

It is great for creating logos, labels, branding projects, magazines, mugs, flyers, posters, and much more, and it is also perfectly readable in the text.

‍Download Poligon now

4. Military font

If you’re looking for a symbolic military font to use for design and branding purposes, then the Military font might be the one for you.

An ideal military font that portrays patriotism and integrity.

This typeface is one of the most unique and classic military fonts that you can have as a logo designer.

As you can see in the photo above, the Military font consists of distinct characters in which there are slant cuts in the letters.

Additionally, some of its letters, like A, B, D, O, P, and others, have star shapes inside, which is very ideal if you want your design to look like it’s different from others.

And those stars are included because the military font was inspired by the United States flag.

It also portrays patriotism, integrity, and dignity, and it is widely used as wallpaper, pattern fills, web page backgrounds, and surface textures.

This Military font is perfect for making army posters, clothing prints, logos, and any other military design project.

‍Download Military font now

5. Bootcamp

The Bootcamp is definitely an ideal choice for creatives that are looking for a military font that includes a variant Morse code.

Bootcamp is the best military font for online game design.

It is a military condensed style font that was first conceptualized for a WW1 commemorative design solution for veterans.

The designer of Bootcamp realized that a good complement to it would be a Morse code variant, a very common form of communication at the time.

Between the dots and dashes comes a two-font family that represents simpler times, when sacrifice for brothers and country was without question.

It comes with a total count of 197 glyphs, an all-caps character set with no variants that includes all numbers and punctuation.

So if you want the best military font for designing army or navy-themed online games, Bootcamp will be a great choice.

‍Download Bootcamp now

6. The Old Navy

If you’re looking for the best font for military-style branding, I’m sure that you will love the Old Navy typeface.

The Old Navy is the best military typeface for branding.

This is a new stencil style font collection that is ideal for decorating any of your creative projects.

You can also use them to create a logo or use them for small businesses, t-shirts, book covers, stationery, marketing, blogs, magazines, and more.

‍The Old Navy consists of all capital letter characters and has a messy or dusty look.

This military font is also best used for designing apparel like shirts, caps, etc.

‍Download The Old Navy now

7. Chaser

Another ideal military font in this list is this Chaser, which is inspired by aviation and stencil style.

Chaser is the best military font for posters.

This font also includes several illustrations that may be useful for creating your project and will be a useful addition.

The Chaser typeface includes three sections: clean, rough, and printed styles.

It also includes stencil-themed symbols, which are best for designing army, navy, and air force-inspired posters.

This military font is also perfect for designing t-shirt prints and souvenirs.

‍Download Chaser now

8. Northolt

The next typeface on my list is named after the town where its designer spent years of his childhood, which is Northolt.

Northolt is the best slab serif military font for designers.

This font family has been inspired by the town's military history, especially the famous airfield.

It comes in light, regular, bold, distressed, and rough versions, which allow you to choose which style is suitable for your needs.‍

In fact, the Northolt is a versatile military font that can be used by designers to create logos, posters, and others.

So if you’re looking for the best slab serif military typeface for design and branding, look no further than the Northolt font.

‍Download Northolt now

9. Union Force

If you want to have one of the most popular and classic military fonts to use for design and branding purposes, the Union Force will be a great choice.

Union Force is the best military font for t-shirt design.

This typeface is a stencil display sans font that can give a vintage look to any design project that you’re planning to do.

As you can see in the picture above, Union Force comes with sharp-edged characters that can portray braveness and strength.

That’s what makes this military font ideal for men’s apparel design since it has a very masculine vibe.

Additionally, Union Force is also a perfect typeface to use for army-inspired posters and game designs.

‍Download Union Force now

10. Autobahn SVG

And as for the last military font in this list, I don’t want to miss the Autobahn SVG, which is a spray paint-inspired typeface.

The Autobahn is one of the most unique military fonts.

As you can see in the sample picture below, this stencil font has a very distinct design, and its letters are not equally colored.

Some people might think that this font has a messy look, but if you’re a designer, you’ll know that Autobahn SVG is an ideal font for logos and other design projects.

It features a realistic spray paint appearance as well as a dripping paint effect, which makes it different from other military fonts.

It also includes a bold and sloppy style of writing to portray strong emotions as well as a distinct personality.

‍Download Autobahn SVG now

Conclusions

Military fonts are one of the most popular types of fonts for logo designers since they provide a very distinct and strong look to any design project.

What is a military font?

Military fonts are typefaces associated with the armed forces.

These fonts are typically stencils, but they can also be serif, sans-serif, or any other type of display font.

They are now recognized in various forms of branding and design due to their widespread use in mainstream media.

That's why it is very important for a logo designer to have only the best military style font.

It will allow them to come up with a visually appealing military-inspired logo that will surely impress their clients.

To name a few of the best military fonts to use for design and branding, Poligon and Airborne 86 are must-haves.

I've included a total of 10 ideal military fonts so you can have a wider option to choose from.
